findings.detail: close sets closed before awaiting active completion; concurrent second close returns before drain/lock removal. Cache and return one closure promise to all callers.

Two dispatch calls can pass prepared identity/released checks before either awaited health callback resolves, then both return the same completion. Claim one-use dispatch synchronously before health await; reject second caller. Existing release guard prevents duplicate HTTP but not duplicate API acceptance.

verified_scope: Native measured callback is paused before model dispatch; budget/capture work can precede release.
Cumulative arm ledger binding stays single while per-request recycler checkpoints remain separate.
Existing tests cover paused abort/close/health and oversized/foreign preparation.
